extension_description.message: Select chart candles, match dates, and run local volume-price and Wyckoff analysis from 30-minute to monthly periods.

extension_description_dev.message: Development build for selecting chart candles and running local volume-price and Wyckoff analysis on supported market pages.

popup_privacy.message: Processes market data only from supported pages and generates analysis locally.

disclaimer.message: Results are for technical research only and are not investment advice.

drawer_privacy.message: Market data and analysis results are not uploaded to a developer server.

drawer_selection_image_candles.message: $COUNT$ candle positions detected. Date matching and analysis start automatically.

drawer_selection_failed.message: The selected image could not be read. Select the chart again.

drawer_loading_description.message: Fetching and matching market data. You can cancel safely; late results will be discarded.

drawer_recovery_title.message: The analysis panel needs to recover

drawer_recovery_description.message: An unexpected display error was contained. Reload the panel to return to a clean state.

drawer_empty_description.message: Refresh the market page, then select the target area. The extension will identify OHLCV data from page requests.

drawer_window_selection.message: Final market-data range matched from the selected image.

drawer_window_manual.message: Final market-data range used by this configured analysis.

drawer_chart_summary.message: This analysis and chart use the latest $COUNT$ candles.

drawer_chart_summary_tradingview.message: Following the current TradingView chart, this analysis and chart use the latest $COUNT$ candles.

drawer_chart_no_volume.message: The current chart data has no volume. Only candlesticks are shown, and analysis is limited to price structure.

drawer_settings_locked_tradingview.message: TradingView follows the current chart period and captured data. These settings cannot be changed here.

drawer_settings_description.message: Analysis and charting use the same candle count. Valid settings are saved; click Start Analysis to apply them.

status_syncing.message: Syncing the current tab market context

status_active_site.message: $SITE$ recognized. Market data will be requested when analysis starts.

status_tradingview_waiting.message: Waiting for the TradingView page to stream market data

status_active_unsupported.message: Active market-data requests are not supported on this page

evidence_price_only_detail.message: Usable volume is unavailable, so no volume-confirmed Wyckoff stage or trading signal is produced.

evidence_b003_detail.message: Price broke above prior range resistance on high volume.

evidence_s003_detail.message: Price broke below prior range support on high volume.

evidence_b001_detail.message: Price quickly recovered after moving below support.

evidence_s002_detail.message: Price reached a new high while average volume declined.

evidence_b004_detail.message: Price remains in a narrow range while awaiting breakout confirmation.

evidence_trend_up_detail.message: Price remained in an upward trend during the analysis window.

evidence_trend_down_detail.message: Price remained in a downward trend during the analysis window.

warning_active_request_fallback.message: The active market-data request failed. This run uses data passively captured from the page.

warning_insufficient_data.message: Insufficient data: at least $COUNT$ candles are required.

warning_short_analysis_window.message: This result uses only $COUNT$ candles. Short samples are supported, but confidence is limited until 20 or more candles are available.

warning_missing_volume.message: Volume is missing, so volume-price analysis cannot be performed reliably.

warning_ignored_candles.message: Ignored $COUNT$ invalid or duplicate candle records.

warning_unclear_structure.message: The current price-volume structure is unclear. Wait for confirmation.

error_extension_unavailable.message: This page cannot connect to the Chrome extension service.

error_current_tab_not_found.message: The current tab could not be found.

error_analyzable_tab_not_found.message: No active tab is available for analysis.

error_open_side_panel.message: The analysis side panel could not be opened.

error_refresh_page_state.message: The page state could not be refreshed.

error_sync_tab.message: The current tab could not be synchronized.

error_initialize_page.message: The page state could not be initialized.

error_start_selection.message: Candlestick selection could not connect to this market page. Refresh the page once and try again.

error_selection_capture_failed.message: The selected chart image could not be captured. Keep the market tab active and select it again.

error_selection_period_unrecognized.message: The selected chart period could not be identified. Keep the period control visible and select the candlesticks again.

error_selection_period_unsupported.message: The selected period ($PERIOD$) is unsupported. The minimum supported period is 30 minutes.

error_selection_range_unrecognized.message: Candles were detected, but their date range could not be matched reliably to the requested market data.

error_selection_stale.message: This selection was replaced before analysis started.

error_selection_date_evidence_insufficie.message: $ACTUAL$ clear candle directions were found. Five candles are enough to calculate, but at least $REQUIRED$ clear directions are needed to match dates uniquely from an image.

error_selection_candles_insufficient.message: The selection contains $ACTUAL$ candles. At least $REQUIRED$ are required; select at least $REQUIRED$ consecutive candles.

error_tab_switching.message: The current tab is changing. Try the analysis again shortly.

error_result_context_changed.message: The result belongs to a different tab context, so stale page data was not displayed.

error_analysis_retry.message: Analysis failed. Refresh the market page and try again.

error_analysis_service.message: The analysis service could not be reached.

error_cancel_analysis.message: The analysis could not be cancelled completely. Reset the analyzer before trying again.

error_reset_analyzer.message: The analyzer could not be reset completely. Refresh the market page and try again.

error_page_context_missing.message: The current market page could not be confirmed. Refresh and try again.

error_page_context_changed.message: The current tab has changed. Wait for page synchronization, then run the analysis again.

error_page_context_changed_during_analys.message: The market page changed during analysis, so the stale result was discarded.

error_market_data_tradingview_not_found.message: No TradingView market data has been captured yet. Wait for the chart to load or change its period, then try again.

error_market_data_not_found.message: No market data was found. Confirm the current page symbol and try again.

error_analysis_failed.message: The calculation failed. Check the strategy settings or refresh the market page and try again.

error_config_period_invalid.message: The market period is invalid. Select it again.

error_config_candle_count_integer.message: The analysis candle count must be an integer.

error_config_candle_count_min.message: At least $COUNT$ candles are required for analysis. Enter a larger value.

guidance_selection_retry.message: Select the intended candle range again; only the latest selection is analyzed.

guidance_selection_keep_tab_active.message: Keep the market tab visible and active until the selected image appears in the panel.

guidance_selection_period_visible.message: Keep the selected chart period control visible so 30m, 1h, 4h, daily, weekly, or monthly can be identified.

guidance_selection_supported_period.message: Switch the main chart to a supported period; 30 minutes is the minimum.

guidance_selection_include_five.message: Select at least 5 consecutive candle bodies.

guidance_selection_clear_bodies.message: Zoom the chart until candle bodies and wicks are visibly separated; very compressed or doji-heavy ranges are harder to count.

guidance_selection_main_chart.message: Select one continuous section of the main candlestick plot, including its date axis when practical.

guidance_selection_avoid_overlays.message: Exclude order books, pop-ups, floating price labels, and separate indicator panels from the selection.

guidance_selection_recent_range.message: For older history, move the chart so the selected dates are visible and near the current chart viewport before selecting.

guidance_selection_date_range_missing.message: The market source did not return enough candles inside the matched start and end dates; suspended or missing intervals can cause this.

error_config_candle_count_max.message: The analysis candle count cannot exceed the current page limit of $COUNT$.

error_market_data_invalid.message: The captured market data contains no valid candles. Confirm the symbol and period, then refresh the page.

error_analysis_candles_insufficient.message: Only $ACTUAL$ valid candles are available; the strategy requires $REQUIRED$.

error_page_url_invalid.message: The current market-page address is invalid. Refresh and try again.

error_binance_symbol_unrecognized.message: The trading pair could not be identified from the Binance page.

error_tonghuashun_symbol_unrecognized.message: The stock code could not be identified from the Tonghuashun page.

error_market_request_timeout.message: The market-data request timed out. Check the network and try again.

error_binance_market_request_failed.message: The active Binance market-data request failed.

error_tonghuashun_market_request_failed.message: The active Tonghuashun market-data request failed.

error_binance_response_parse.message: The Binance market-data response could not be parsed.

error_binance_response_format.message: The Binance market-data response has an invalid format.

error_tonghuashun_response_format.message: The Tonghuashun market-data response has an invalid format.

error_tonghuashun_response_parse.message: The Tonghuashun market-data response could not be parsed.

error_tonghuashun_response_missing_candl.message: The Tonghuashun response contains no candlestick data.
